Bookmark of this page has been deleted. Listen to New GuruFocus Podcast: Interview With Quant Guru Jim O’Shaughnessy O'Shaughnessy talks about his winning strategy January 03, 2018 | About: AAPL +0% 
Jim O’Shaughnessy wrote the wildly popular investing book, “What Works on Wall Street,” in which he documents the strategies that sank or soared during over long periods, with some surprising results. In the podcast with GuruFocus, Jim expounds on the follies of predicting markets and how a composite approach outperforms. It’s only possible, he says, if you can eliminate those pesky emotions. 
Jim also touches on why Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) should not make acquisitions, which ratios aren't all they are touted to be and what Warren Buffett ( Trades , Portfolio ) may be wrong about.
